candidates.name: Sister Mary Joseph nodule with metastatic adenocarcinoma of colonic origin
support_spans: a firm nodule at the umbilicus

candidates.name: Sister Mary Joseph nodule
support_spans: A 55-year-old man with no significant medical history presented with a 10-month history of spontaneous, progressively painful umbilical discomfort
A few days after the onset of pain, he noted a firm nodule at the umbilicus that gradually increased in size and became ulcerated and tender
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a firm nodule at the umbilicus that gradually increased in size and became ulcerated and tender is consistent with Sister Mary Joseph nodule, a rare metastatic lesion to the umbilicus.
